capabilities: Insert entries, items, monsters, tables and keywords via right-click commands
Play the book in a side pane with dice, fights, items and endings
Validate dead choices, undeclared items and unreachable sections
Simulate fights and paths to report win rates and difficulty
Export web packages, print .idml and .epub with shared entry numbers
disambiguation: Not just a publishing exporter; it also writes, plays, validates and simulates the gamebook inside Obsidian.
extras: Free to use but closed source (MIT License); no network requests, telemetry or account needed to write, play or export; install by hand or via BRAT until it reaches Obsidian's community list.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write, playtest and export branching gamebooks with dice, stat blocks, items and locked choices.
